title: Tonelli sliding-window identity for left intervals
statement: Let ν be an s-finite Borel measure on ℝ (for example any finite Borel measure) and let h ∈ ℝ. Then the function t ↦ ν((t − h, t)) from ℝ to [0, ∞] is Borel measurable. Its [0, ∞]-valued Lebesgue integral with respect to Lebesgue measure on ℝ is ∫⁻ ν((t − h, t)) dt = ENNReal.ofReal(h)·ν(ℝ). Here (t − h, t) = {x : t − h < x < t} is the open interval, which is empty when h ≤ 0, and ENNReal.ofReal(h) = max(h, 0) ∈ [0, ∞).
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) [SFinite ν] (h : ℝ), Measurable (fun t : ℝ => ν (Ioo (t - h) t)) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ν (Ioo (t - h) t) ∂volume = ENNReal.ofReal h * ν univ
